fields.headline: Hot, green and festive
fields.note: Hot and humid with tropical showers; cyclone season.
fields.highlight: New Year celebrations and Thaipoosam Cavadee.

fields.headline: Warm sea, lush island
fields.note: The hottest, wettest month; cyclones are possible.
fields.highlight: Chinese Spring Festival in Port Louis.

fields.headline: Summer winds down
fields.note: Still hot, with fewer showers towards the end.
fields.highlight: Maha Shivaratri pilgrimage to Grand Bassin; Independence Day (12 March).

fields.headline: Calm and sunny
fields.note: Warm days and cooler evenings; rain eases off.

fields.headline: Great for hiking
fields.note: Dry, sunny and pleasant - ideal for the trails.
fields.highlight: Labour Day (1 May); the hiking season begins.

fields.headline: Cool and breezy
fields.note: Winter starts: cooler, windier, especially in the south.

fields.headline: Winter on the island
fields.note: Coolest month; sunny on the north and west coasts.
fields.highlight: Humpback whales arrive off the west coast.

fields.headline: Whale watching
fields.note: Cool and dry, with steady trade winds.
fields.highlight: Whale and dolphin watching; European summer holidays.

fields.headline: Bright and dry
fields.note: One of the driest months; long sunny days.
fields.highlight: Diwali (festival of lights) - date varies, Oct/Nov.

fields.headline: Warm sea again
fields.note: Hot days and a warm sea; perfect for the beach.
fields.highlight: Diwali and Arrival of Indentured Labourers Day (2 November).

fields.headline: Summer holidays
fields.note: Hot and sunny with the first summer showers.
fields.highlight: Christmas, New Year festivities and flamboyant trees in bloom.

fields.name: North
fields.tagline: Lively towns, beaches and cultural spots.
fields.description: Charming towns, historic landmarks and golden beaches: discover the vibrant spirit of the North
fields.about_text: The North is a captivating blend of heritage, culture and natural beauty. From lush gardens and historic landmarks to vibrant towns and dreamy beaches, the North offers something special for every traveler.
fields.travel_tip: Visit the beaches and Grand Baie early in the morning or late afternoon to avoid the midday heat and crowds, and enjoy the best light for sunsets.

fields.name: Aliyah C.
fields.bio: Local ocean lover leading sustainable snorkeling tours in Blue Bay Marine Park and catamaran sails to eastern islets.
fields.why_travel_with_me:
In-depth knowledge of Mauritius's marine ecosystem.
  Eco-friendly and responsible tourism practices.
  Personalised and memorable experiences.
  Passionate about protecting our oceans and island for future generations.
fields.detailed_specialities:
Marine Life Discovery
  Sea Turtle Encounters
  Island & Coastal Exploration
  Coral Reef Conservation
  Ocean Education
  Snorkeling & Lagoon Exploration

fields.name: John W.
fields.bio: John has 8+ years of guiding travelers through Mauritius's cultural heritage and local architecture.
fields.why_travel_with_me:
Deep knowledge of Mauritius's colonial and cultural history.
Access to hidden historical sites most tours miss.
Engaging storytelling that brings the island's past to life.
Passionate about preserving and sharing local heritage.
fields.detailed_specialities:
Colonial History & Heritage Sites
Museum & Cultural Tours
Architectural Landmarks
Local Traditions & Folklore
Plantation & Tea Estate History
Guided Walking Tours

fields.name: Mithili J
fields.bio: Third-generation tea lover guiding tastings across Mauritius’s tea estates and spice gardens, sharing the story behind every cup.
fields.specialities: Tea tasting, Spice gardens, Local cuisine
fields.why_travel_with_me:
-Deep knowledge of Mauritian tea and spice traditions
-Hands-on tastings, not just talk
-Relaxed pace suited to families and small groups
-Insider stops that most tours skip

fields.name: kevin R
fields.bio: Mountain-born trail guide leading hikes through the Black River Gorges, to hidden waterfalls and up to Mauritius’s best viewpoints.
fields.why_travel_with_me:
-Safe, well-planned trails for every fitness level
-First-aid trained and fully equipped
-Local knowledge of the island’s rare birds and plants
-Flexible pace, with photo stops along the way

fields.title: Underwater Adventure
fields.description: Discover the lagoon's coral gardens and marine life on a submarine safari and underwater scooter trek, then enjoy a seafood lunch on an islet.
fields.includes:
Local seafood lunch served on islet
Submarine safari & scooter trek

fields.title: Bois Chéri Tea Route & Tasting Tour
fields.description: Follow the tea route through the Bois Chéri plantation, visit the museum and factory, and finish with a tasting overlooking the south coast.
fields.includes:
Tea Plantation Tour
Museum entry & factory visit
Panoramic tea tasting session

fields.text: Aliyah was amazing! Her knowledge about marine life is incredible and she made our experience both fun and educational. Highly recommend!

John's tour of the tea plantation was fascinating from start to finish. He clearly loves this island's history and it shows — every stop had a story behind it. One of the best guided tours we've done anywhere.
